subject: Initial vendor intake: Verdance sustainability & diversity packet
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@verdance.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Jun 2025 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Initial vendor intake: Verdance sustainability & diversity packet

Hi Elena —

Thanks for choosing Redwood for the upcoming integration. I’m Soojin on the Vendor Enablement team; I’ll own the procurement onboarding for Verdance. To get your account set up and the first PO issued, we need a few intake artifacts from your side. I’ve summarized the minimum required items below so we can keep this to a short kickoff.

Required to start vendor setup:
- Completed vendor intake form (basic company/legal details) — link below if you prefer filling a spreadsheet
- W9 / W-8 or equivalent tax docs (if applicable)
- Banking / ACH instructions or vendor portal enrollment details
- Certificate(s) of insurance (COI) — general liability and professional liability if available

Supplier diversity & ESG items (can be provided within 10 business days):
- Supplier Diversity Certification (if you have one) OR a short statement on ownership (minority/women/Veteran status)
- Sustainability questionnaire: please complete the attached Verdance_Sustainability_Questionnaire_2025.xlsx (high level — ~10–12 questions)
- Modern slavery / human trafficking attestation (if you already have a policy document, attach; otherwise a signed statement is fine)

Attachments: [Attachment: Verdance_Sustainability_Questionnaire_2025.xlsx]

Next steps: once you return the questionnaire and tax/banking docs, we’ll provision a vendor record and aim to issue the initial PO within 5 business days (assuming no outstanding compliance requests). If you’d like, I can set up a short 20-minute call to walk through the questionnaire.

Thanks — looking forward to working together.

—
Soojin Lee
Vendor Enablement Manager
Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

Company portal: https://redwood.example/vendor-portal

Hi Soojin —

Thanks for the clear checklist, and great to meet you. We’d like the 20-minute walkthrough — will Marco from our operations team join? He can handle the tax/bank paperwork. I’ve attached our diversity certificate (see stub below) and will return the completed sustainability questionnaire by end of day Friday (CEST).

Quick notes:
- Diversity: Verdance is certified as a minority-owned business in Italy (cert attached). If you need a translated cert or notarized copy, let us know.
- Sustainability questions: a few answers will require confirmation from our supply chain lead, but nothing blocking.
- COI: we can provide the general liability COI by next Tuesday.

Attachments: [Attachment stub: Vendor_Diversity_Cert.pdf (scanned certificate)]

Can you confirm whether Redwood needs the modern slavery attestation on company letterhead or if a signed PDF is acceptable?

Best,
Elena Rossi
Head of Procurement Operations
Verdance Biotech LLC
elena@verdance.com | +39 02 555 0102

Elena / Marco —

This plan sounds good. A few quick confirmations and next steps:

1) Modern slavery attestation: a signed PDF on company letterhead is fine for our records. If you have a one-page policy, attach that as well; otherwise the signed attestation is sufficient.

2) Upload method: please use our secure vendor portal link (one-time upload link) so the files land directly in our procurement system. I’m sharing the link here: https://redwood.example/vendor-portal/upload?token=abc123 (expires in 7 days). If you prefer SFTP, we can provide credentials — tell me and I’ll loop in IT.

3) Temporary acceptance: we can provision a vendor record off the scanned diversity cert to allow the initial PO, but the COI must arrive before the first payment is released. We’ll mark the record as "Provisional — COI pending."

4) Timeline: once we receive the filled questionnaire + tax docs + COI, target for PO issuance is 3 business days. If any items are delayed, we’ll escalate to Finance for an exception.

If helpful, I’ll schedule a 20-minute walkthrough tomorrow at 10:30am PT. Please reply with confirmation and attendees.

Thanks and talk soon —
—
Soojin Lee
Vendor Enablement Manager
Redwood Inference
